name: Fleet Roster Wall
purpose: this wall lists all 250 of Wren's direct operatives by trade category, drawn live from the F47 fleet roster registry.
concierge_blurb: All 250 of Wren's direct operatives are listed by trade. None are dispatched without her say-so.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: category_counts in the registry sum to exactly 250 and are visitor-safe (just integers per trade) — mirror them verbatim, do NOT recompute from the operatives[] array (drift risk). Every operative carries advisory_only=true, execution_allowed=false, dispatched=false; surface the advisory_only flag at the wall so visitors never assume the fleet acts autonomously. The roster sits ABOVE the 1377 tower-wide pool (qsb_wren_team_roster) — these 250 are Wren's direct operatives, not the whole worker pool.
